mapper.select: SELECT PET_ID AS petId, PET_NAME AS petName, PET_TYPE AS petType, PET_BREED AS petBreed, PET_AGE AS petAge, IS_MAIN AS isMain FROM pet_profile WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} ORDER BY IS_MAIN DESC, PET_ID ASC
SELECT RES_ID AS resId, RES_TITLE AS resTitle, RES_DATE AS resDate, RES_STATUS AS resStatus FROM reservation WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} ORDER BY RES_DATE DESC LIMIT 2
SELECT ORDER_ID AS orderId, PRODUCT_NAME AS productName, ORDER_DATE AS orderDate, DELIVERY_STATUS AS deliveryStatus FROM orders WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} ORDER BY ORDER_DATE DESC LIMIT 2
SELECT PLAN_NAME AS planName, END_DATE AS endDate, SUB_STATUS AS subStatus FROM subscription WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} ORDER BY SUB_ID DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT FAV_ID AS favId, FAV_NAME AS favName, FAV_TYPE AS favType FROM favorites WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} ORDER BY FAV_ID DESC LIMIT 4
